page.overview:
Who is Timpani Guff?

Timpani Guff is a firbolg associated with the The Re-Slayer's Take. He is played by Nick Williams.

Timpani is a robust firbolg man, with skin covered with bluish hair, red-headed, and with a lush mustache of the same color. He has gained weight in the last century, and in the recent battles he has lost a couple of teeth.

He is a cheerful man, bumbling and sincere, and described as a "crackpot", with a certain sense of spectacle.

Timpani came from the Dwendalian Empire, but he traveled to Vasselheim and tried to join the Slayer's Take at some point before 636 PD, failing because he didn't have the right skills. He tried multiple times, unsuccessfully, with the last attempt being around 739 PD, period during which he visited Shoresight Isle when he was still "in school" and with ties with the guild; there he befriended Duderonomous. After returning to Issylra and being rejected again, he chose to live a life of isolation, traveling to many places, although keeping an apartment in Vasselheim where he was occasionally joined by hia cousin Pumat Sol, who visited last around 829 PD. He, however, ended up noticing strange phenomena involving monsters once defeated by the guild, so he started taking notes about the subject to show it to them, although he wasn't believed, making him suspect they knew something and were covering it. He met Gurt Stumpstuck during this time, and together they designed a magical way to access the dwarf's bog, using a specific tree with a special password, and protecting it against non-magical damage. At one point, while traveling through the Utesspire Mountains, he met Poogs, a goblin who had ran away from his community; although the latter tried to steal from him, Timpani showed him only kindness, which caused the Curse of Strife to be lifted. Very thankful, Poogs gave him a cupcake, and they became friends.
